brief:
Israeli bulldozers razed Khirbet Samra, one of the Jordan Valley's last Palestinian communities, on Sunday, Middle East Eye reported. The demolition left residents homeless as they surveyed the destruction of their settlement.

Despite the destruction, residents vowed to remain in the area. Khirbet Samra's fate reflects the ongoing pressure faced by Palestinian communities in the Jordan Valley, a territory where Israeli settlements and military operations have steadily displaced Palestinians.

title: Israeli bulldozers destroy Jordan Valley Palestinian community
